types.name: ResearchCommons.NANUQ.ContiguousCopies.extreme_bounds
types.printed_type:
@NANUQ.ContiguousCopies.extreme_bounds : ∀ {Taxon : Type u_1} {m : ℕ} (taxon : Fin m → Taxon) (i : Fin m),
  ∃ f g,
    taxon f = taxon i ∧
      taxon g = taxon i ∧ NANUQ.ContiguousCopies.First taxon f ∧ NANUQ.ContiguousCopies.Last taxon g ∧ f ≤ i ∧ i ≤ g

types.name: ResearchCommons.NANUQ.ContiguousCopies.same_interval_side_extreme
types.printed_type:
@NANUQ.ContiguousCopies.same_interval_side_extreme : ∀ {Taxon : Type u_1} {m : ℕ} (taxon : Fin m → Taxon),
  NANUQ.ContiguousCopies.Contiguous taxon →
    ∀ (l r : Fin m),
      (∃ a b, NANUQ.ContiguousCopies.InInterval l r a ∧ NANUQ.ContiguousCopies.InInterval l r b ∧ taxon a ≠ taxon b) →
        ∀ (i : Fin m),
          ∃ e,
            NANUQ.ContiguousCopies.Extreme taxon e ∧
              taxon e = taxon i ∧ (NANUQ.ContiguousCopies.InInterval l r e ↔ NANUQ.ContiguousCopies.InInterval l r i)

types.name: ResearchCommons.NANUQ.ContiguousCopies.extreme_card_le_two
types.printed_type:
@NANUQ.ContiguousCopies.extreme_card_le_two : ∀ {Taxon : Type u_1} {m : ℕ} [inst : Fintype Taxon]
  (taxon : Fin m → Taxon), Nat.card { i // NANUQ.ContiguousCopies.Extreme taxon i } ≤ 2 * Fintype.card Taxon

types.name: ResearchCommons.NANUQ.ContiguousCopies.cut_quartet_extremes_iff
types.printed_type:
@NANUQ.ContiguousCopies.cut_quartet_extremes_iff : ∀ {Taxon : Type u_1} {m : ℕ} (taxon : Fin m → Taxon),
  NANUQ.ContiguousCopies.Contiguous taxon →
    ∀ (l r : Fin m) (a b c d : Taxon),
      a ≠ b →
        (NANUQ.ContiguousCopies.CutQuartet taxon (NANUQ.ContiguousCopies.Extreme taxon) l r a b c d ↔
          NANUQ.ContiguousCopies.CutQuartet taxon (fun x => True) l r a b c d)

types.name: ResearchCommons.NANUQ.ContiguousCopies.selection_side_extremes
types.printed_type:
@NANUQ.ContiguousCopies.selection_side_extremes : ∀ {Taxon : Type u_1} {m : ℕ} (taxon : Fin m → Taxon),
  NANUQ.ContiguousCopies.Contiguous taxon →
    ∀ (pick : Taxon → Fin m),
      (∀ (t : Taxon), taxon (pick t) = t) →
        ∀ (l r : Fin m),
          (∃ a b,
              NANUQ.ContiguousCopies.InInterval l r a ∧ NANUQ.ContiguousCopies.InInterval l r b ∧ taxon a ≠ taxon b) →
            ∃ chosen,
              (∀ (t : Taxon), NANUQ.ContiguousCopies.Extreme taxon (chosen t)) ∧
                (∀ (t : Taxon), taxon (chosen t) = t) ∧
                  ∀ (t : Taxon),
                    NANUQ.ContiguousCopies.InInterval l r (chosen t) ↔ NANUQ.ContiguousCopies.InInterval l r (pick t)

types.name: ResearchCommons.NANUQ.ContiguousCopies.cut_split_extremes_iff
types.printed_type:
@NANUQ.ContiguousCopies.cut_split_extremes_iff : ∀ {Taxon : Type u_1} {m : ℕ} (taxon : Fin m → Taxon),
  NANUQ.ContiguousCopies.Contiguous taxon →
    ∀ (l r : Fin m) (left : Taxon → Prop),
      (∃ a b, left a ∧ left b ∧ a ≠ b) →
        (NANUQ.ContiguousCopies.CutSplit taxon (NANUQ.ContiguousCopies.Extreme taxon) l r left ↔
          NANUQ.ContiguousCopies.CutSplit taxon (fun x => True) l r left)
